items.question: Can I change plans later?
items.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time; the change applies from the next billing period.

items.question: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
items.answer: Every paid plan starts with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: All major credit cards and SEPA direct debit.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes. Cancel in your account settings and keep access until the end of the billing period.
